remarks: Welcome to 1541 Oenoke Ridge, a spectacular country retreat with unparalleled privacy and natural beauty. Beyond the stately stone pillars, you are greeted by 4.5 beautifully landscaped acres including manicured gardens, a lighted tennis/sports court, a swimming pool, a 1-bedroom guest/pool house and a cozy stone fire pit. The main house blends elegance with everyday comfort. Highlights: spacious custom chef's kitchen with dining area, magnificent great room with cathedral ceiling and a paneled wood-burning fireplace, dining room with bay window and a family room with its own fireplace and French doors opening to the wrap around deck overlooking a serene and bucolic backdrop. A perfect setting for entertaining. Ideal for everyday living. Upstairs, the sun-filled primary suite offers a vaulted ceiling, dressing room and luxurious marble bath. Three more bedrooms, one en-suite, and a hall bath complete the second floor. The walk-out lower level is equipped with a kitchenette and full bath, providing flexible space for recreation, work or extended living. Overlooking the heated pool, the charming guest house is perfect for weekend guests, in-laws, a private office or a fitness studio. Whether hosting gatherings or enjoying quiet moments at home, this remarkable property offers endless possibilities. A rare opportunity not to be missed.
